EndpointConfig.description: One LLM access point (provider + creds + base URL).

provider.description: LiteLLM provider family. Common values: 'azure', 'openai', 'anthropic', 'bedrock'. Used for documentation and validation only; the actual provider is selected by the prefix on `litellm_model`.
provider.title: Provider

api_base.description: Base URL for the endpoint. Supports ${ENV_VAR} interpolation. May be None for providers that don't use a base URL (e.g. OpenAI direct).
api_base.title: Api Base

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key. The key itself never appears in the YAML. May be None for endpoints that require no auth (e.g. local Ollama).
api_key_env.title: Api Key Env

EndpointConfig.title: EndpointConfig

ModelRoute.description:
A logical model id pointing at one endpoint + a LiteLLM model string.

This is endpoint-routing config (*where* a model lives), distinct from
``corallab.schemas.eval.run_manifest.ModelCallConfig`` (*how* a model is
called: sampling params).

endpoint.description: Name of the endpoint (key in `endpoints:`) this model lives on.
endpoint.title: Endpoint

litellm_model.description: The actual model string LiteLLM expects, e.g. 'azure/gpt-5.1', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'openai/llama3:70b'.
litellm_model.title: Litellm Model

base_model.description: Optional LiteLLM catalog id for Azure custom deployment names. Forwarded as model_info.base_model so LiteLLM can resolve max tokens, capabilities, and cost tracking without logging 'Could not identify azure model' warnings.
base_model.title: Base Model

ModelRoute.title: ModelRoute

description: Top-level registry: named endpoints + named models.
title: LLM Endpoint Registry
